b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: A pressure tactic that shortens the time available for checking and deciding.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: A pressure tactic that shortens the time available for checking and deciding.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: 確認や判断にかかる時間を短くしてertificationを急がせる手法。「今日中にサインするか、Salvador，价格が変わる」というようにする。
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: 確認や判断にかかる時間を短くする、Compression absent pressure tactic.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: 검토하거나 결정할 시간을 부족하게 만들어 곧바로 행동하도록 재촉하는 수법이다.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: 확인과 결정에 쓸 시간을 줄여 재촉하는 압박 수법.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Tática de pressão que cria uma sensação de urgência, encurtando o prazo para impedir conferências ou reflexões. Nem todo prazo é artificial; a questão é se ele foi usado de forma enganosa para restringir a escolha.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: Redução do tempo disponível para verificar informações e tomar uma decisão.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Taktik tekanan yang memperpendek waktu yang tersedia untuk memeriksa dan memutuskan. Kata ini digunakan untuk menjelaskan cara mendorong seseorang bertindak cepat dengan sedikit waktu untuk berpikir.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: Taktik tekanan yang memperpendek waktu untuk memeriksa dan memutuskan.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: กลวิธีกดดันที่บีบเวลาให้สั้นลงเพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้บุคคลตรวจสอบหรือตัดสินใจอย่างรอบคอบ
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: กลวิธีสร้างความเร่งด่วนจนเหลือเวลาไม่พอตรวจสอบและตัดสินใจ

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Son tarih veya geçici fırsat gösterilerek kişinin kontrol yapmadan hemen karar vermesinin sağlanması. Amaç, karar süresini kısaltarak düşünme ve karşılaştırma fırsatını ortadan kaldırmaktır.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: Aciliyet: Kontrol etme ve karar verme için bırakılan süreyi kısaltan baskı taktiği.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.translation: Aciliyet, telefon aramasını engellemek için oluşturulmuştu: bu gece imzala, yoksa fiyat değişecekti.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: The shortening of the time you have to think before you decide.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: 期限や数を限 thereby、考える時間を短縮して即座に決めさせること。切迫感 Away from the actual deadline can also be created artificially。
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: 検討時間を短くし、すぐ判断を求める切迫感。

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: 결정하거나 행동하기 전에 주어진 시간이 짧아지는 상황. 곧바로 대응해야 한다는 압박을 강조할 때 쓰며, 실제 시간이 반드시 줄어든다는 뜻으로만 쓰지는 않는다.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: 결정하기 전에 생각할 시간이 짧아지는 상황.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Condição que limit�� o tempo para analisar as opções antes de escolher. A pressa pode reduzir a qualidade da decisão, mas nem sempre indica uma oferta genuinamente urgente.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: A redução do tempo disponível para pensar antes de decidir.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Urgensi adalah situasi yang mendorong seseorang memutuskan dengan lebih cepat tanpa banyak pertimbangan. Tekanan ini dapat berasal dari tenggat waktu yang nyata atau sengaja dibuat untuk reacted.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: Pemendekan waktu berpikir sebelum mengambil keputusan.

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: การลดเวลาให้คิดและตัดสินใจซึ่งอาจทำให้ข้อจำกัดเวลาดูเป็นเรื่องเร่งด่วนกว่าที่ควรเป็น

b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.definition: Bir kişiyi hızlı karar vermeye yönlendiren, süre baskısı yaratan durumdur. Aciliyet bazen gerçek olsa da çoğu zaman karar kalitesini düşüren yapay bir zaman sınırıdır.
b68aadd9eb8f334acbd4a42c9a01696277885c7e.gloss: Karar vermeden önce düşünmek için kalan sürenin kısaltılması.
